answer_1.quote: We employ five publicly available benchmarks with well-defined quantitative metrics covering four task categories. • Reasoning Task. GSM8K ... • Code Generation Task. HumanEval ... • Creative Writing Task. Trivia Creative Writing ... • Text Comprehension Task. HotpotQA ...
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated outputs in tasks involving reasoning, code generation, creative writing, and text comprehension, which include natural language generation components such as narrative generation in Trivia Creative Writing and multi-step reasoning in math problems.

answer_2.quote: We assess the quality of generated solutions via accuracy (%), with the full dataset for testing.
automatic_metrics: automatic metric score (proportion of correct answer mentions)

answer_3.quote: We asses using Claude-3.5-Sonnect as the evaluation model to rate the responses on a scale from 0 to 10.
methods: confidence score assessment in validation module
